sources.selection: Source-proportional sample, disjoint from a separate Granary evaluation sample

training.text_preparation: Preserve case and punctuation; remove literal <unk> annotations from TED-LIUM and collapse its whitespace; split training lines at whitespace to at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes
training.origin: Arguments of NeMo's scripts/tokenizers/process_asr_text_tokenizer.py with --tokenizer spe --spe_type bpe --vocab_size 1023 --no_lower_case --spe_character_coverage 1.0 --spe_max_sentencepiece_length 512
